newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MAERSK AND DUTCH ECT NEAR AGREEMENT ON TERMINAL.
newsitem.headline: MAERSK AND DUTCH ECT NEAR AGREEMENT ON TERMINAL.

text.p: Danish shipping line Maersk and Dutch-owned European Combined Terminals (ECT) are nearing agreement over joint operation of a container terminal in Rotterdam, the Rotterdam port authority said on Wednesday.
"The companies have completed the first phase of negotiations with agreement on the principle of operating a terminal as partners," the port authority said in a statement.
It said the two needed to decide on the location of the terminal and details of their cooperation and would continue their discussions over the summer.
ECT is owned about 30 percent by each of Nedlloyd , Internatio-Mueller and Pakhoed, with state-owned Dutch Railways holding the other 10 percent.
